subtitle: On the cold sun of Makar Sankranti, an empire gambles everything on an empty stomach

panels.shot: epic low-angle wide of a battlefield plain under a pale winter sun
panels.action: Sadashivrao Bhau sits tall on his war elephant amid a vast, tense host on the dusty Panipat plain, winter haze and rows of cannon stretching to the horizon as the cold sun hangs over a waiting clash.

dialogue.text: Panipat, 14 January 1761: Sadashivrao Bhau leads a starving empire into one last, burning throw of the dice.

i18n.hi: पानीपत, 14 जनवरी 1761: सदाशिवराव भाऊ भूखा साम्राज्य लेकर आखिरी, धधकता दांव खेलता है

panels.shot: slow aerial drift over a parched camp at dawn
panels.action: A vast Maratha camp of worn tents and gaunt bullocks spreads over the frost-bitten plain, cooking fires almost dead as thin figures huddle in shawls against the hard dawn.

dialogue.text: For months the northern Maratha army lay trapped near Panipat, hemmed in by Afghan horse and cut from grain, grass and aid.

i18n.hi: महीनों से उत्तर की मराठा फौज पानीपत के पास फँसी पड़ी थी, अफ़ग़ान घुड़सवारों ने घेर रखा, अनाज, चारा, मदद सब कटा हुआ

panels.shot: medium close-up inside a command tent, lantern light flickering
panels.action: Inside a cramped tent, Sadashivrao Bhau, shoulders cloaked in wool, studies a rough map by oil lamp, his face lined with worry as a faint cough of hungry camp followers filters through the canvas.

dialogue.text: Sadashivrao Bhau had taken Delhi the year before, but found no lasting allies, no reliable revenue, only enemies circling closer.

i18n.hi: सदाशिवराव भाऊ ने पिछला साल दिल्ली ली थी, पर टिकाऊ साथी न मिले, न पक्की आमदनी, बस दुश्मन ही दुश्मन घेरते गए

panels.shot: tight close-up on Sadashivrao Bhau’s eyes, reflecting a dim campfire
panels.action: Sadashivrao Bhau’s eyes, tired yet resolute, catch the flicker of a dying fire outside, the faint outlines of women and children moving in the shadows beyond.

dialogue.text: Behind his guns trailed a city on the move—families, traders, servants—each extra mouth another grain of sand slipping from his hand.

i18n.hi: तोपों के पीछे-पीछे चल रहा था चलता-फिरता शहर — घर, व्यापारी, नौकर — हर अतिरिक्त मुँह उसकी मुट्ठी से फिसलती रेत

panels.shot: low-angle interior shot as Bhau rises to his feet, decision made
panels.action: Sadashivrao Bhau rises sharply from a low stool, fist tightening on the hilt at his waist, as the faint trumpet of an elephant echoes outside the tent.

dialogue.text: Afghan riders swept the countryside. Najib-ud-Daula and Shuja-ud-Daula sealed the rivers. The Maratha granaries stood empty.

i18n.hi: अफ़ग़ान सवार देहात झाड़ रहे थे। नजीब-उद-दौला और शुजाअ-उद-दौला ने नदियाँ बन्द कर दीं। मराठा कोठार सूने पड़े थे

panels.shot: medium shot of Bhau stepping out of the tent into grey morning
panels.action: Sadashivrao Bhau steps out into the chill morning, breath misting, as officers straighten and namaste, the endless lines of hungry soldiers stretching behind them.

dialogue.speaker: sadashivrao_bhau
dialogue.text: We break this ring today, or we wither behind it.

i18n.hi: आज ये घेरा तोड़ेंगे, वरना इसके पीछे ही सूख कर गिरेंगे

panels.shot: wide shot of the Afghan-Durrani camp across the plain, dawn haze
panels.action: Across the plain, the Afghan lines under Ahmad Shah Durrani rise in ordered rows, cavalry horses being saddled, green and black standards lifting in the faint breeze.

dialogue.text: Opposite stood Ahmad Shah Durrani, his Afghan and Rohilla horse fresh, his lines supplied by the Ganga plains and his allies’ treasuries.

i18n.hi: सामने खड़ा था अहमद शाह दुर्रानी; अफ़ग़ान और रोहिल्ला घोड़े ताज़ा, और उसकी पंक्तियों को गंगा का मैदान और साथियों के खजाने खिलाते रहे

panels.shot: dynamic tracking shot along Maratha artillery line facing the Afghan camp
panels.action: A long line of heavy cannon stands entrenched, gunners in dark turbans readying charges while behind them ranks of infantry in disciplined formations await the call.

dialogue.text: Between these camps lay the field, marked by trenches and guns—especially the disciplined infantry and artillery of Ibrahim Khan Gardi, the sharp edge of Bhau’s hope.

i18n.hi: दोनों डेरों के बीच पड़ा था मैदान, खाइयों और तोपों से सजा — खासकर इब्राहिम ख़ान गार्डी की सधी पैदल और तोपें, भाऊ की उम्मीद की धार

panels.shot: wide, almost overhead shot of the Maratha battle array forming at sunrise
panels.action: Under the pale rising sun, the Maratha army deploys in depth, guns anchored in the center, cavalry wings sweeping outwards as elephants lumber to the fore.

dialogue.text: On Makar Sankranti’s dawn, Bhau chose to burst the noose—advance with all, crush the Afghan center, and carry his starving host southward through blood.

i18n.hi: मकर संक्रांति की भोर पर भाऊ ने फाँसी का फंदा फाड़ने का फैसला किया — सबको साथ लेकर बढ़ना, अफ़ग़ान बीच चीरना, और खून के रास्ते भूखी फौज को दक्षिण निकालना

panels.shot: medium close on a gaunt Maratha foot-soldier adjusting his turban, resolved
panels.action: A thin, bearded Maratha foot-soldier tightens his turban and grips his matchlock, eyes hollow yet steady as dust swirls around his bare feet.

dialogue.text: Men who had chewed on boiled leather now tightened belts and wrapped ragged shawls, readying themselves for one clear task—break through or die standing.

i18n.hi: जिन मर्दों ने उबली खाल चबाई थी, वही पेटी कसी, फटी चादरें ओढ़ीं, एक ही हुक्म के लिए तैयार हुए — आर-पार तोड़ो या खड़े-खड़े मर जाओ

panels.shot: low, dramatic shot of Ibrahim Khan Gardi’s battalion and guns firing
panels.action: Lines of Ibrahim Khan Gardi’s uniformed infantry unleash a coordinated volley as their cannon roar, smoke billowing forward toward advancing Afghan horse.

dialogue.text: At first the plan held. Ibrahim Khan Gardi’s guns and drilled lines tore into the Afghan van, checking even the famous Abdali cavalry.

i18n.hi: शुरुआत में चाल जमी रही। इब्राहिम ख़ान गार्डी की तोपें और सधी कतारें अफ़ग़ान अगुआ पर टूट पड़ीं, यहाँ तक कि नामी अबदाली सवार भी थम गए

panels.shot: wide shot showing Afghan cavalry veering around the Maratha flank in dust
panels.action: Afghan and Rohilla cavalry sweep in a great arc around the Maratha flank, hooves kicking up clouds as their banners bend like dark birds.

dialogue.text: But the enemy did not only charge the front. Light Afghan and Rohilla horse skirted the flanks, harassing, probing, waiting for any break in formation.

i18n.hi: पर वार सिर्फ सामने से नहीं था। हलके अफ़ग़ान और रोहिल्ला घुड़सवार किनारों से सरकते रहे, तंग करते, टटोलते, बस कहीं से पंक्ति टूटने का इंतज़ार

panels.shot: heroic low-angle of Sadashivrao Bhau atop his elephant in the center
panels.action: Sadashivrao Bhau stands in a howdah atop his war elephant, sword drawn, gesturing forward as the massive beast pushes behind the Maratha guns.

dialogue.text: Bhau himself rode forward with the household troops and elephants, pressing the center hard, trusting his artillery and infantry to hold the line behind.

i18n.hi: भाऊ खुद हुकुमी फौज और हाथियों के साथ आगे निकला, बीच पर ज़ोर डालता हुआ, पीछे की पंक्ति थामने को अपनी तोपों और पैदल पर भरोसा किए

panels.shot: medium wide of the Maratha right wing, cavalry pressed and wavering
panels.action: On the right, Maratha horsemen jostle and shout amid dust, some mounts rearing as Afghans press in, the neat ranks dissolving into knots of riders.

dialogue.text: Yet as the hours dragged, the overloaded Maratha wings began to fray. Horses lacked fodder; men lacked reserves. Order thinned into patches of desperate courage.

i18n.hi: पर जैसे-जैसे घड़ी खिंचती गई, बोझ से दबी मराठा बाँहें घिसने लगीं। घोड़ों के पास चारा नहीं, सिपाहियों के पास राहत नहीं। अनुशासन जगह-जगह सिर्फ जान तोड़ बहादुरी पर टिक गया

panels.shot: close on a Maratha gun position as ammunition boxes lie nearly empty
panels.action: At a battered gun position, a gunner stares at an almost empty ammunition chest while another man gestures helplessly towards the distant Afghan lines.

dialogue.text: Powder and shot ran low. Months of blockade had starved not only bellies but wagons and animals; every round fired that day had been carried at great cost.

i18n.hi: बारूद और गोलियाँ घटने लगीं। महीनों की नाकेबंदी ने पेट ही नहीं, बैलगाड़ियों और जानवरों को भी सुखा दिया था; उस दिन चला हर गोला बड़ी कीमत पर लाया गया था

panels.shot: wide shot of battlefield at midday haze, piles of abandoned gear and swirling cavalry
panels.action: In the harsh midday light, the field is a chaos of swirling cavalry, fallen standards, and abandoned carts, as the once-straight Maratha lines twist and buckle.

dialogue.text: The Afghan king used his strength carefully, feeding in fresh troops, conserving his fire, while Bhau had brought almost everything onto the field at once.

i18n.hi: अफ़ग़ान बादशाह ने ताकत सोच-समझकर खर्च की, ताज़ी फौजें टुकड़ों में उतारीं, आग बचाए रखी; उधर भाऊ लगभग सब कुछ एक साथ मैदान में ले आया था

panels.shot: intense close-up of a young nobleman on horseback identified by royal finery
panels.action: A young noble in rich Maratha finery, face smeared with dust, turns sharply in his saddle toward a sudden commotion amid the household troops.

dialogue.text: Amid that storm rode Vishwasrao, the Peshwa’s heir, close to Bhau. In the crush of men and elephants, a shot found him; the hope of Pune fell in an instant.

i18n.hi: उसी तूफ़ान में चलता था विश्वासराव, पेशवा का वारिस, भाऊ के क़रीब। आदमी और हाथियों की ठोंक-पोंक में एक गोली लगी; एक पल में पूना की आस ढह पड़ी

panels.shot: medium shot of Sadashivrao Bhau on his elephant hearing the news, shoulders sagging
panels.action: On the elephant howdah, Sadashivrao Bhau’s shoulders sag as an officer leans in, his face ashen, while the thunder of battle rages around them.

dialogue.text: When word of Vishwasrao’s death reached Bhau, it struck at the very heart of his army, already stretched, already fighting on emptiness and memory.

i18n.hi: विश्वासराव की मौत की खबर भाऊ तक पहुँची तो पहले से खिंची, याद और खाली पेट पर लड़ती फौज के दिल पर सीधा वार हुआ

panels.shot: dramatic side shot of Bhau dismounting from his elephant amid chaos
panels.action: Sadashivrao Bhau, face grim, steps down from his elephant with the help of a guard, drawing his sword as he prepares to fight on foot among his men.

dialogue.text: Accounts tell of Bhau leaving his elephant to fight among his soldiers on foot, trying to rally a center now sagging under repeated Afghan blows.

i18n.hi: किस्से कहते हैं कि भाऊ हाथी से उतरकर पैदल सिपाहियों के बीच जा मिला, टूटते बीच को दुबारा कसने की कोशिश में, जो अफ़ग़ान धक्कों से झुक चुका था

panels.shot: low wide shot of exhausted Maratha infantry locked in close melee, faces strained
panels.action: Exhausted Maratha infantry stand shoulder to shoulder, arms raised, faces strained with effort as foes press against them, the ground churned to a dusty blur under their feet.

dialogue.text: The close of the day became a press of bodies and will. Ammunition spent, many fought hand to hand, their formations collapsing into clumps of last stands.

i18n.hi: दिन का आखिरी हिस्सा सिर्फ देहों और हौसले की भिड़ंत बन गया। गोला-बारूद खत्म, बहुतों ने हाथापाई शुरू की, उनकी कतारें टूटकर आखिरी मोर्चों में बिखर गईं

panels.shot: wide aerial shot of the Maratha lines breaking and flowing backward
panels.action: From above, parts of the Maratha line can be seen breaking, streams of men and elephants pulling back as Afghan cavalry pour into the gaps.

dialogue.text: Once the line broke in places, Afghan horse poured through, rolling up units from the rear, while weary Maratha wings could no longer close the breaches.

i18n.hi: जहाँ-जहाँ पंक्ति टूटी, अफ़ग़ान घोड़े लहर की तरह घुसे, पीछे से दस्तों को लपेटते गए, और थकी मराठा बाँहें अब उन सुराखों को भर ही न सकीं

panels.shot: somber medium shot of Bhau fighting amid a knot of loyal guards, silhouettes
panels.action: Amid a small knot of loyal guards, Sadashivrao Bhau’s silhouette is seen striking out, cloaked in dust and smoke, as enemy horsemen converge from all sides.

dialogue.text: In the tangle of dust and steel, Bhau vanished. Most sources hold that he fell there, around his personal guard; later stories of escape remain unproven.

i18n.hi: धूल और लोहे की उस उलझन में भाऊ ग़ायब हो गया। ज़्यादातर बयान मानते हैं कि वह वहीं अपनी निज़ामी रखवाली के बीच गिरा; बाद की ‘बच निकलने’ की कहानियाँ साबित नहीं

panels.shot: wide twilight shot of the battlefield strewn with discarded weapons and silent forms
panels.action: As evening falls, the battlefield stretches silent and grey, scattered with broken lances, toppled standards and the still forms of men and animals.

dialogue.text: By nightfall, the Maratha host was shattered. Chroniclers speak of tens of thousands lost, though exact numbers drift between memory and fear.

i18n.hi: संध्या तक मराठा फौज चूर हो चुकी थी। बाबू लिखते हैं, दर्जनों हज़ार मारे गए, चाहे सही गिनती याद और दहशत के बीच डगमगाती रहे

panels.shot: medium wide of captured Maratha soldiers herded under guard, heads bowed
panels.action: Lines of captured Maratha soldiers stand under guard, heads bowed, while armed Afghans watch, some gesturing toward a distant camp.

dialogue.text: Kashi Raja’s account from Shuja-ud-Daula’s camp describes prisoners taken and many later slain, a grim reprisal in the flush of victory.

i18n.hi: काशीराजा का बयान, शुजाअ-उद-दौला के डेरों से, बताता है कैदी बनाए गए और बहुतों को बाद में मार डाला गया — जीत के नशे में किया गया सख़्त बदला

panels.shot: interior shot of Ahmad Shah Durrani’s tent, maps and spoils laid out
panels.action: Inside a large tent, Afghan officers stand around Ahmad Shah Durrani, who studies a spread of maps and seized standards laid on the floor coverings.

dialogue.text: Ahmad Shah Durrani had checked Maratha expansion in the north, but his own empire was a tapestry of distant tribes; he withdrew, leaving a wounded, contested heartland behind.

i18n.hi: अहमद शाह दुर्रानी ने उत्तर में मराठा फैलाव रोक दिया, पर उसका अपना साम्राज्य भी दूर-दूर की कबीलों की रजाई था; वह लौट गया, पीछे घावों से भरा, झगड़ालू दिल छोड़कर

panels.shot: melancholic wide shot of Pune’s skyline imagined, with newsbearer arriving at dusk
panels.action: An exhausted courier on horseback rides into Pune at dusk, the outlines of the city’s walls and spires dark against a fading sky as people gather anxiously.

dialogue.text: In Pune, the news fell like a monsoon of ash. The Peshwa’s court, built on a decade of victories, suddenly faced widowhood, succession and questions of blame.

i18n.hi: पूना में खबर राख की बरसात जैसी गिरी। दस साल की जीतों पर खड़ी पेशवा दरबार पर एक साथ विधवापन, उत्तराधिकारी और दोष के सवाल टूट पड़े

panels.shot: medium shot of a scholar in later years reading a bakhar manuscript by lamplight
panels.action: Years later, a Maratha scribe sits bent over a manuscript, lamplight catching the black ink lines as he copies an account of Panipat into a bound bakhar.

dialogue.text: Bakhars, colonial histories and modern studies all trace many causes—starvation, broken alliances, heavy non-combatants, and a confederacy whose parts could not pull together on that one cold day.

i18n.hi: बखरें, अंग्रेज़ी राज के इतिहास और नए शोध सब कई वजहें जोड़ते हैं — भूख, टूटे गठजोड़, भारी गैर-लड़ाके, और ऐसा संघ जो उस एक ठंडी घड़ी में मिलकर नहीं खिंच पाया

panels.shot: symbolic wide shot of the sun rising over the Deccan hills years later
panels.action: The sun rises over the rolling Deccan hills, new forts and towns visible in the distance, as traders and soldiers move along a dusty road below.

dialogue.text: Yet Panipat was not an end. The Marathas rebuilt, learned, and would again shape the subcontinent, carrying the scar of that Sankranti as a warning stitched into power’s cloth.

i18n.hi: पर पानीपत आख़िरी रेखा नहीं था। मराठों ने दुबारा खड़ा होना सीखा, फिर से उपमहाद्वीप को आकार दिया, उस संक्रांति का घाव ताकत की चादर पर टांकी हुई चेतावनी बनाकर

subtitle_i18n.en: On the cold sun of Makar Sankranti, an empire gambles everything on an empty stomach
subtitle_i18n.hi: मकर संक्रांति के ठंडे सूरज पर, एक साम्राज्य खाली पेट सब कुछ दांव पर लगा बैठा
